issues.problem: Repairable citation and contract failures in the live review pipeline did not receive bounded model feedback and full revalidation; unsafe recovery could mutate the source context, create positives from invalid responses, repeat indefinitely or use another concurrent invocation's receipt.
issues.implementation: A maximum of one conditional revision reuses the exact original source pool, per-event allowlists and discovery event catalog. Initial-response MODEL_OMITTED_EVENT_ID and MODEL_DUPLICATED_EVENT_ID fallback markers are mechanical repair triggers only when the original request hash exists; unmarked semantic uncertainty is not expanded. Structured SEMANTIC_PROOF and EVIDENCE_RELATION technical errors are localized by event, EvidenceObject, field, source, citation span and rule, with explicit revision limits; after-choice, unresolved and conflict findings are not positive-repair triggers. Each returned object is schema-checked, immutable-identity checked and mechanically revalidated. Missing/duplicate targets and failures preserve the original classification. Failed transport receipts are accepted only from the invocation-bound ModelRequestFailed with consistent task, hash and failed status; shared receipt lists are never read. Synthetic success receipts bind the canonical repair payload. Production fresh/cache receipts separately bind transport request identity, canonical payload, returned result and terminal evidence; the two hash domains are never equated. Parent/repair request, prompt, schema and cache identities are retained, with absent provider versions marked UNKNOWN_NOT_SUPPLIED.
issues.limitations: Passing schema, citation and contract checks does not establish clinical semantic correctness or make a physician blind-review packet. Existing original facts remain authoritative.

issues.problem: Real parent review-feedback requests can exceed the 240,000-character preparation budget before any provider call. An uncontrolled retry would silently truncate clinical text, discard original source/EO/prior authority or bypass cached-request authentication.
issues.implementation: Explicitly opt-in version review-compact-repair-0.2.0 preserves the original full parent pool, allowlists, event inputs, current document, prior IDs, identity siblings, EvidenceObject and clock hashes as immutable authority. It renders selected exact source windows, including declared EO and selected previous-event comparison/action/connection quotations, while the ordinary full revalidator continues to resolve every returned quotation against the original raw sources and saved allowlists. Compact coordinate/ledger receipts are hashes rather than duplicate narrative; omitted display is not absence or a negative finding. No text is truncated to fit a budget. Legacy full-pool behavior and independent authentication remain distinct. External repair calls require separate scope authorization and are not enabled by this code change.
issues.limitations: Selected windows are not complete evidence visibility and are not equivalent to a complete fresh clinical review. Offline compilation does not prove model semantic repair success, clinical recall, accuracy or release. SCALE-01 through SCALE-06 provide 77 real pre-provider budget-failure groups, all 77 of which compiled within 240,000 characters offline; SCALE-05 also has four preparation ValueErrors whose stable error codes were not preserved by the frozen implementation, now independently reproduced as structured EvidenceObject ID redaction defects under V04-Q013 rather than capacity failures. New external sends are separately scoped and authorized.

issues.problem: 修复请求的预算失败来自附加开销，而不是父负载本身。冻结 0.7.0 批次 82 个修复分组全部在发起任何提供方请求前失败于 REVIEW_FEEDBACK_PAYLOAD_EXCEEDS_BUDGET；同一批 77 个匹配父复核负载没有一个超过 240000（中位数 237283、最大 238000），而修复负载中位数为 330820：original_proposals、validation_feedback 与 REPAIR_INSTRUCTIONS 把已接近上限的父负载推出了预算。
issues.implementation: 只把交给 client.ask 的字节做无损池编码（payload_codec.transport_projection），规范修复负载与其 hash 不变；original_payload、prepare_payload、evaluate._input、run_review_feedback 在读取边界解码。编码失败、字段未分类或编码不更小时回退为原样发送并如实记录格式。同时把非可重试 4xx 视为本次调用终止并归还未使用的尝试次数，输入溢出另记字段而不改写 PROVIDER_HTTP_<status> 的 reason_code。
